purpose: Every resource or category that the project goal names, with the catalogue records that cover it. The state of each is computed in GOAL_RESOURCES.md from the lifecycle of its records; nothing here asserts that a resource is usable.

resources.name: Ensembl VEP and its plugins
resources.note: Plugin catalogue (74 plugins) and release-116 plugin data listings are recorded; MaveDB and LOEUF plugin files are acquired; SpliceAI, SpliceVault, Enformer and the other plugin data sets are listed with sizes and not mirrored.

resources.name: GENCODE
resources.note: The Ensembl release-116 GTF (the GENCODE gene set for human) is mirrored with its checksum.

resources.name: MANE
resources.note: MANE v1.5 summary and GTF acquired; transcripts on alternate and patch sequences resolve through the RefSeq report and MANE Select agrees with the RefSeq annotation for 99.8% of transcripts.

resources.name: RefSeq
resources.note: Assembly report, regions, alternate-locus placement, feature counts and the GFF3 annotation of GRCh38.p14 (release RS_2025_08) acquired with published MD5s.

resources.name: dbNSFP
resources.note: Registration is required for the data; its predictors reach the library separately (AlphaMissense, CADD scores in gnomAD INFO).

resources.name: MaveDB
resources.note: Existing verified asset: 1,402 human-target score sets and their tables.

resources.name: ProteinGym
resources.note: 217 substitution and 66 indel DMS assays acquired and checked row by row; overlap with MaveDB experiments not yet matched.

resources.name: MAVE and deep mutational scanning data
resources.note: Two independent routes; each experiment must be counted once.

resources.name: MPRA and reporter-assay variant effects
resources.note: MaveDB holds MPRA score sets; MPRAVarDB is catalogued and deferred until its licence and genome build are known.

resources.name: Knock-in and rescue experiments
resources.note: No catalogued source: such experiments live in the literature and in model-organism allele and construct records (the Alliance bucket has ALLELE and CONSTRUCT directories, not fetched).

resources.name: gnomAD
resources.note: Allele-frequency slices at MaveDB-mapped regions, constraint metrics and the SV/CNV callsets acquired; LD matrices (GRCh37, large) deferred.

resources.name: 1000 Genomes
resources.note: Sample metadata and release files catalogued; the project page and tutorials are the existing NHGRI asset.

resources.name: GWAS Catalog
resources.note: Associations and studies tables acquired.

resources.name: Open Targets
resources.note: 27 of 61 datasets of release 26.09 acquired and validated.

resources.name: Linkage disequilibrium
resources.note: LDlink is an on-demand service and is not acquired; gnomAD LD matrices are deferred; LD can be computed from phased 1000 Genomes genotypes.

resources.name: Fine-mapping and colocalisation
resources.note: Open Targets credible sets and the eQTL Catalogue fine-mapping are the sources; the large colocalisation dataset is deferred.

resources.name: GTEx
resources.note: v11 gene median TPM and the dataset API acquired.

resources.name: ENCODE and candidate cis-regulatory elements
resources.note: SCREEN cCRE class BED files acquired.

resources.name: eQTL Catalogue
resources.note: Catalogued; summary statistics and credible sets are not acquired.

resources.name: eQTL and sQTL
resources.note: GTEx and eQTL Catalogue are catalogued for this; association files are not yet acquired.

resources.name: Chromatin accessibility and binding
resources.note: cCRE classification only; signal tracks are not acquired.

resources.name: Tissue and cell-type specificity
resources.note: GTEx median TPM and HPA consensus tissue and single-cell-type tables acquired.

resources.name: DepMap
resources.note: Blocked for automation (human-verification page); not circumvented.

resources.name: IMPC
resources.note: Catalogued; data files are not acquired.

resources.name: BioGRID ORCS
resources.note: Human screens acquired.

resources.name: Natural human knockouts
resources.note: Constraint metrics and gnomAD LoF curation acquired.

resources.name: Knockout and knockdown screens
resources.note: BioGRID ORCS acquired; others catalogued.

resources.name: CRISPR interference and activation
resources.note: BioGRID ORCS records screen types; the share of interference and activation screens was not counted.

resources.name: Overexpression and gene dosage
resources.note: ClinGen dosage curation and BioGRID dosage-rescue and dosage-lethality interactions acquired.

resources.name: ClinVar
resources.note: GRCh38 VCF acquired; records on RefSeq NT_/NW_ contigs resolve through the assembly report.

resources.name: ClinGen
resources.note: Dosage, recurrent-region and gene-validity files acquired.

resources.name: PharmGKB (ClinPGx)
resources.note: Annotation archives acquired.

resources.name: PharmVar
resources.note: Complete database 6.2.29 acquired (CC BY-SA 4.0, research use).

resources.name: CPIC
resources.note: Gene and guideline lists and eight database API tables (allele definitions, locations, function, phenotypes, diplotypes, recommendations) acquired.

resources.name: PharmCAT
resources.note: A tool applying the CPIC and ClinPGx tables; catalogued, not acquired.

resources.name: UniProt
resources.note: Reviewed human entries and the humsavar variant index acquired.

resources.name: InterPro
resources.note: Per-protein annotation of MaveDB proteins acquired.

resources.name: AlphaFold DB
resources.note: Canonical models of MaveDB proteins acquired.

resources.name: Reactome
resources.note: Pathway and mapping tables acquired.

resources.name: Interaction databases
resources.note: BioGRID (physical and genetic) acquired; IntAct, STRING and Reactome interactions reach the library through the Open Targets interaction dataset.

resources.name: PDB residue mappings
resources.note: SIFTS mappings acquired.

resources.name: Copy-number and structural variation
resources.note: gnomAD-SV/CNV, DGV, ClinGen regions and HGSVC3 acquired; dbVar deferred; DECIPHER is restricted.

resources.name: Short tandem repeats, VNTRs and repeat expansions
resources.note: STRchive disease loci acquired; the genome-wide TRExplorer catalogue is deferred until its licence is known.

resources.name: Complex pharmacogene loci
resources.note: PharmVar and CPIC acquired; HLA and KIR allele databases are not mirrored (no-derivatives licence, mirroring discouraged).

resources.name: Callability and region reliability
resources.note: GIAB difficult-region stratifications, alternate-locus placement and HGSVC3 repeat flags acquired.

resources.name: Mitochondrial DNA variants
resources.note: MITOMAP refuses automated access; CPIC supplies MT-RNR1 alleles only.

resources.name: FAIRsharing
resources.note: Registration required; not acquired.

resources.name: bio.tools and OpenEBench
resources.note: API refused automated clients; OpenEBench counts recorded.
